questions.q: The National Investment Policy for Urea (NIPU 2026) aims to achieve what specific goal for the country?
options: Halving the cost of imported urea
Expansion of urea exports to international markets
Complete replacement of all urea with organic fertilizers
questions.explain: Reducing dependency on foreign imports for this key fertilizer is essential for our agricultural stability. The policy’s structure ensures financial viability for plants, encouraging private, public, and cooperative entities to set up new units.

questions.q: What is a central concern raised by civil society groups regarding the proposal to set up seven hill councils in Ladakh?
options: A lack of local language schools within the councils
They believe the councils should focus only on defense
It will cost too much to maintain the office buildings
Institutional overlap and the erosion of authority in future representative bodies
questions.explain: Local leaders worry that spreading power too thin between seven councils might undermine the effectiveness of a unified body proposed under Article 371. The lingering trust deficit with the center has made the public quite wary of top-down administrative reconfigurations.

questions.q: Regarding the RBI's new framework for Specified Non-Financial Assets (SNFAs), which of the following statements is correct?
options: The framework will be applicable from January 1, 2026.
SNFAs are classified as part of a bank's Gross NPA portfolio.
Banks must dispose of these immovable assets within a seven-year window.
The regulation allows banks to sell acquired properties back to the original borrowers.
questions.explain: Strict timelines prevent lenders from holding onto non-core real estate indefinitely, requiring liquidation within seven years. Keep in mind that this RBI mandate aligns with the broader goal of focusing banks on lending rather than property management, a recurring theme in modern financial sector reforms.

questions.q: Which of the following is true about how banks must record the value of an SNFA?
options: It is based solely on the market value as decided by the bank's internal committee.
It must be the higher of the loan's book value or the independent valuation.
The value is fixed at the original purchase price paid by the borrower.
Assets are recorded at the lower of the outstanding loan value or the distress sale price.
questions.explain: To maintain realistic balance sheets, the central bank mandates using the lower of the loan's net book value or an independent valuation. Such conservative accounting standards are crucial for preventing inflated valuations, often referenced in debates concerning financial transparency in UPSC economic papers.

questions.q: In the context of the recent FIFA World Cup controversy involving Argentina, what is the primary reason for FIFA's strict neutrality policy?
options: To ensure the tournament remains focused exclusively on ticket sales.
To adhere to long-standing regulations prohibiting political or personal slogans on the pitch.
To force neutral diplomatic stances between South American and European nations.
To avoid potential financial penalties from sponsoring corporations.
questions.explain: Football's global governing body strictly prohibits any political, religious, or personal messaging to prevent the sport from becoming a theater for territorial or ideological disputes. Historically, Article 5 of the FIFA Code of Ethics explicitly forbids discriminatory behavior and political intervention in match venues.

questions.q: Which ministry implements the newly approved Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme (MPMS) aimed at deepening India's value chain?

questions.explain: Moving beyond mere assembly, this initiative seeks to boost R&D and indigenous brand ownership within the electronics sector. It's an interesting evolution from the previous PLI-based strategies, designed to help India capture more economic value while meeting Viksit Bharat goals.

questions.q: What is the primary objective of providing an additional 3% incentive to Indian brands under the new MPMS?
options: To encourage domestic investment in product design and R&D.
To help them compete specifically in the budget-feature phone market.
To subsidize their retail electricity costs.
To cover losses incurred from exporting to Western markets.
questions.explain: The scheme recognizes that India lacks homegrown smartphone champions because we've relied on foreign technology for too long. By incentivizing R&D, the govt's essentially trying to bridge the 10-15% cost disadvantage that local players face against global giants.

questions.q: What is the primary function of the CMF's Combined Task Force 154 (CTF 154)?
options: Conducting full-scale naval warfare in the South Atlantic.
Regulating commercial fishing boundaries in the Indian Ocean.
Focused professional maritime security training for partner nations.
Providing humanitarian aid during extreme climate events.

Exercises like Southern Readiness help standardize response tactics, which is essential given India's strategic interest in protecting maritime trade routes.

questions.q: Cyclosporiasis is a foodborne illness transmitted via which of the following pathways?
options: Airborne transmission in crowded indoor markets.
Contact with the saliva of infected domesticated animals.
A fecal-oral route through contaminated water or produce.
Bites from infected mosquitoes found near damp regions.
questions.explain: Caused by a tiny parasite called Cyclospora, this infection primarily hitches a ride on fresh leafy greens or contaminated water supplies. It's helpful to note for medical science sections of exams that this isn't contagious from one person to another.

questions.q: Why is the newly discovered damselfly species 'Lestes paloti' considered unique?
options: It is the only damselfly found in high-altitude desert regions.
It feeds exclusively on invasive plant species in Kerala.
It can fly faster than any other species in the Odonata order.
It is the first of its genus described in India since 1987.
questions.explain: Researchers found this insect within the Western Ghats, marking a significant update to Indian biodiversity records. Interestingly, these creatures change color based on the season, shifting from brown to blue when the monsoon arrives.

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of the PARIVARTAN scheme within the National Capital Region?
options: Constructing new highway networks to bypass dense city traffic.
Upgrading existing railway lines to high-speed standards.
Subsidizing public transport fares for commuters in urban slums.
Accelerating the shift from polluting vehicles to cleaner fuel options like EVs.
questions.explain: This policy aims to clean up the air by helping truck and bus owners transition away from older, emission-heavy models. Funding comes through the NCRPB, reflecting a multi-state collaborative approach to the serious pollution crisis in northern India.

options: A consortium of international private banks.
The World Bank's regional office in Kathmandu.

It is an indigenously built vessel from Cochin Shipyard Limited.
